While short starts were common in the US/Canada, the 10,000m event is a standardized international distance where 10,000 meters is exactly 25 laps of a 400m track (or equivalent fractional laps on 440yd tracks). The Planner failed to verify the actual lap definition for the race distance rather than assuming a track standard that yields a non-integer or incorrect count for the specific metric distance, leading to the wrong final answer of 24 instead of the mathematically and historically accurate 25.
